metrics.citationCoverage: supported claims with >=1 valid sourceId / all supported claims
metrics.invalidCitationRate: citations whose sourceId is absent from returned sources / all citations
metrics.unsupportedClaimRate: supported-status claims not entailed by evidence / all supported claims
metrics.sourceResolutionRate: sourceIds resolving to source registry entries / all sourceIds
metrics.multilingualSchemaPass: responses preserving schema and requested locale / multilingual cases
metrics.cacheHitRate: cached grounded responses / eligible grounded requests
